family.title: Your family
family.subtitle: Watch each founder’s territory grow.
family.emptyBody: When you link and verify a kid’s account, their learning territory appears here.
family.territorySubtitle: Everything the course teaches — and how much is already theirs.

games.title: Games
games.subtitle: Each game practises something this course already taught.
games.emptyBody: Games unlock as lessons get finished. There is no rush — they will be right here whenever they are ready to play.

insightsConsent.label: Share usage insights
insightsConsent.hint: Help improve lessons with anonymous-style usage signals. You can turn this off anytime.

cookies.title: We use our own cookies
cookies.body: A first-party cookie helps us see which pages and campaigns bring people to LittleFounders. It stays on our domain — no ad networks, no cross-site tracking. You can decline and nothing is stored.
